source_investigation.method: Read-only source review after browser testing. No Chrome calls or game source changes in this follow-up.

tip_overlap.conditions: Viewport width <=860px and height <=520px, with a pointer that does not match pointer:coarse. Reproduced at594x466 desktop fine pointer. Coarse-pointer rule at88 clears bottom and therefore does not have this exact stretch.
tip_overlap.cause: Width breakpoint sets top:auto and bottom:max(64px,safe-area-bottom+60px). Later short-height rule sets top:max(46px,safe-area-top+42px) but leaves the earlier bottom. Absolutely positioned auto-height panel stretches between both insets; at466px height with no safe-area inset its border box is356px high.
tip_overlap.minimal_fix: Add bottom:auto to the final @media(max-height:520px) .tip rule at89. Keep the compact top anchor and existing responsive text/width rules.
verification_cases: 594x466 fine pointer: replay new-order and driving tips; panel height follows content, car/road visible, Hide tip and Accept clickable.
860x520 and861x520 fine pointer: check both breakpoint edges and ensure only one vertical anchor is active.
594x700 fine pointer: preserve bottom placement and intrinsic height.
844x390 coarse pointer: preserve top placement; Hide tip remains reachable and controls work.
Open map and pause while tip is visible; Close/Resume remain clickable; then dismiss/replay tips and verify hidden panels stay hidden.

offer_distance_wording.cause: makeOffer calculates o.dist only from pickup to customer. showOffer labels it generically m route. Once accepted, HUD shows player-to-pickup distance. The delivery clock resets to0 on actual collection, so the advertised limit applies after pickup.
offer_distance_wording.minimal_fix: Replace m route with an explicit Pickup to customer distance label and label the time as the delivery window after pickup. This changes no economy or route logic.
offer_distance_wording.recommended_small_addition: Show a separately labeled estimated distance to pickup before Accept, using the current player-to-pickup graph route where available. If graph route is unavailable, label any straight-line fallback as an estimate; do not present it as a measured road route.
suggested_copy: Delivery window: Z s after pickup · base pay N coins + tip
verification_cases: Offer with pickup much farther away than delivery leg (old-city observed285m delivery vs917m pickup): both legs remain clearly distinguished.
Accept offer without moving: pickup HUD corresponds to the approach estimate within route-refresh/heading differences; do not require exact equality if approximated.
Complete actual collection: timer starts at the advertised delivery window and destination switches to customer.
Cancel area selection with pending offer: same order, delivery distance and pay restored; approach distance may refresh from current position.
Long storefront names at594x466: added text fits scrollable offer, both Accept and Another remain reachable.
